title: Model-specific quantization suggestor and safety lattice for catalog defaults
creator: Priya Nair
description:
Goal: Produce a deterministic, per-model recommendation engine (the 'quant-suggestor') that publishes a default quantization profile into the model catalog along with an explicit safety lattice: allowed fallbacks, precision bands, and validation thresholds. This ticket covers engineering work for the suggestor prototype, integration with the calibration harness, CI gating rules, and telemetry hooks for accuracy regression monitoring.

Why: Customers choosing pre-configured quant defaults must have predictable accuracy and safe automatic fallback when a profile causes unacceptable regressions. Current model catalog lacks per-model guidance beyond a generic FP8/INT8 checkbox. This effort reduces trial-and-error for users and minimizes production incidents due to overly aggressive quantization.

Scope:
- Build the suggestor service that consumes calibration artifacts (calibration traces, per-layer sensitivity heatmaps, sample eval metrics) and outputs a recommended profile (precision per-layer or per-shard, per-tensor exceptions) and a safety lattice (primary profile, fallback profiles, validation thresholds).
- Integrate with existing calibration harness to run shadow validation on a representative prompt set and compute pass/fail criteria.
- Add CI gating rules in model onboarding so that a profile cannot be promoted unless it meets defined accuracy bands and latency/cost targets.
- Expose the recommended defaults + safety lattice in the model catalog metadata and add lightweight UX flags for operations teams to pin or override.

Out of scope: automated per-customer profile tuning, UI design for console beyond simple flags, long-tail model types (sparse/mixture-of-experts) which will be separate follow-ups.
acceptance_criteria: Suggestor produces a JSON profile for each tested model containing: precision map, expected token latency delta, estimated cost savings %, and safety lattice with at least two fallback profiles.

Calibration harness runs end-to-end and reports a deterministic accuracy delta (e.g., ROUGE/BLEU/LM-head perplexity or task-specific metric) against baseline float32 and flags pass/fail per threshold.
CI gating blocks model-catalog promotion when recommended primary profile exceeds accuracy regression > 1.5% absolute on predefined benchmarks or when performance regressions violate latency SLOs.
Model catalog metadata shows recommended_profile and safety_lattice fields and is discoverable via API queries.
Telemetry dashboards show per-model quant A/B trend lines (accuracy, latency, cost) and emit alerts when drift exceeds configured bands.
Integration tests cover the suggestor service logic and a smoke run against two representative models (a 7B dense and a 70B dense) using sampled prompts.
Documentation (README + short runbook) describing how to interpret safety lattice and how to pin/rollback a profile in production.
deliverables: quant-suggestor service prototype (containerized) with CLI to submit calibration artifacts
extension to calibration harness to export sensitivity heatmaps and per-layer quant traces
CI gating rules and GitHub Action that verifies recommended_profile meets thresholds
schema changes to model catalog API to include recommended_profile and safety_lattice fields
telemetry dashboard template and alert rules
README and brief runbook for SRE and model-ops
rollout_plan: Phase 1: internal experimental rollout — run suggestor in shadow mode for all new catalog onboarding for 2 weeks and collect telemetry. Phase 2: enable suggested defaults for non-critical models (internal dev only) with automatic fallback enabled. Phase 3: allow public catalog visibility and opt-in for customer projects. Rollback: automatic fallback to the first safe profile in the safety lattice; manual pin via model-catalog API. We will monitor accuracy and latency for 48h after any profile promotion; alert thresholds are configured in telemetry.
calibration_workflow_steps: Generate calibration traces using representative inputs (10k tokens sampled across prompt types)
Compute per-layer activation distributions and quantization error estimates (MSE, KL) for FP8 and INT8 candidates
Run shadow inference across validation prompt sets to measure task-specific metrics (classification accuracy, perplexity, generation quality) and latency/cost delta
Produce sensitivity heatmap and rank layers/shards by error amplification
Quant-suggestor evaluates heatmaps + validation metrics and outputs recommended_profile + two fallback profiles with expected impact estimates
Register artifacts and results into artifact store and update model-catalog staging metadata
validation_datasets: customer-sim-templates (synthetic templates used by model-ops for high-impact models)
ci_checks: end-to-end smoke test against two canonical models
